name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation aligns with the provided context and the interesting fact, ensuring that the response is coherent and relevant to the conversation.

name: Coherence and Cohesion
description: Evaluates the logical flow and connectivity within the generated continuation, ensuring that the response is easy to follow and understand.

name: Fluency and Grammaticality
description: Assesses the grammatical correctness, sentence structure, and overall readability of the generated continuation, ensuring that the response is fluent and grammatically sound.

name: Engagement and Creativity
description: Measures the ability of the generated continuation to engage the user and demonstrate creativity, ensuring that the response is interesting and original.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: Evaluates the correctness and reliability of the information presented in the generated continuation, ensuring that the response is factually accurate and trustworthy.
